# Phase 12 — Local AI Server

## Vision
Introduce optional local inference stack for privacy-sensitive and offline-capable workflows.

## Scope boundaries
- Local model runtime integration
- Hybrid routing between local and cloud providers
- Local STT/TTS and embedding support

## Dependencies on Phase 1
- Provider abstraction and routing policies
- Model capability registry
- Context budgeting and memory retrieval pipeline

## Security constraints
- Isolated model runtime execution
- Credential separation for cloud/local paths
- Strict filesystem and command sandbox boundaries

## Rollout gates
- Hardware capability checks
- Controlled beta with fallback to cloud routing
- Resource and thermal budget validation

## Success criteria
- Stable local provider operation
- Graceful cloud fallback under failures
- Predictable quality/latency trade-offs

## Risks
- Hardware variability and OOM failures
- Model quality drift vs cloud providers
- Operational complexity in dual-runtime mode
